rationale: TSM gapped down ~3.45% on 5.57x relative volume with earnings tomorrow, creating a high-uncertainty event-driven environment where the stock is now recovering toward the upper portion of today's range (81%) but showing the last two 1-minute candles rolling over from the session high of $419.19. The pre-earnings gap and elevated volume make directional conviction difficult — a long risks a fade from resistance near today's high while a short risks continuation of the intraday recovery toward the gap fill. With today already showing a realized loss and the conflicting signals (strong recovery from $407 low vs. rolling over at the high), the risk/reward does not justify entry.
